data.title: As we stand on the threshold of our 32nd year, remember that "Expansion" is not just about growing in numbers…
data.message:
As we stand on the threshold of our 32nd year, remember that "Expansion" is not just about growing in numbers—it is about expanding our faith, broadening our capacity to love, and stretching our hearts to receive the deeper things of God. Every breakthrough you have prayed for is breaking through right now. Do not hold back, for the Lord is lengthening your cords and strengthening your stakes. Your best days are ahead! See you tomorrow, Bacnotan peeps!

#JILLaUnionAt32 #BreakthroughExpansion #JILBacnotan #LaUnionForJesus #Isaiah54
